evals.name: Deterministic 13-Step Boot Sequencing & Infrastructure Gate
evals.prompt: Implement an application bootstrap entry point that connects to PostgreSQL with exponential backoff and sets up SIGTERM hooks before calling server.listen().
evals.expected_output: Orchestrates the 13-step startup sequence, connects to the database store before listening, and binds termination hooks before opening the port.
assertions: Executes startup sequence in strict chronological order from config validation to server listen
Ensures database connection is verified healthy before server.listen() is invoked
Binds OS termination signals (SIGTERM/SIGINT) prior to opening the network port
Restricts main entry point exclusively to technical wiring with zero business logic

evals.name: Process-Level Crash Handlers & Structured Fatal Logging
evals.prompt: Add process-level crash interceptors to a Node.js backend to capture unhandled promise rejections and uncaught exceptions with structured fatal logs.
evals.expected_output: Registers 'unhandledRejection' and 'uncaughtException' listeners that log the error stack as JSON and exit with code 1.
assertions: Emits structured FATAL level log including complete error stack and context
Terminates process with non-zero exit code (1) to prevent degraded zombie state

evals.name: Resilient Database Connection with Exponential Backoff Retries
evals.prompt: Implement an asynchronous database connection pool initializer that retries failed connections 3 times using exponential backoff before aborting.
evals.expected_output: Implements a retry loop with increasing backoff delay and jitter, logging warnings on retries and terminating on final failure.
assertions: Implements minimum 3 retry attempts for transient startup connection failures
Calculates delay using exponential backoff to avoid thundering herd problem
Executes a health check ping query (e.g. 'SELECT 1') to verify connection health
Logs fatal diagnostic error and exits cleanly if all retry attempts fail
